children: Pernod Ricard's latest sales update looks pretty encouraging, analysts at JPMorgan tell investors in a note. The French distiller, maker of Absolut vodka and Captain Morgan rum, booked an organic 0.9% decline in net sales over its fiscal first quarter through September, a gentler drop than the 1.7% decline analysts had forecast. The company pointed to improving trends in the U.S. and a return to depletions growth in China and, despite double-digit declines in both markets, those signs look encouraging, JPM says. "We expect the shares to react positively to the beat and with a likely halo effect on the overall spirits sub-sector," the bank says. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
